claims.reporting_relationship: Researcher paraphrase of MITRE ATT&CK attribution.

claims.text: JumbledPath supports capturing network packets from remote devices. Together with the attributed use, this supports a qualified inference that Salt Typhoon has a remote packet-capture capability through this tool.

limitations: The cards are paraphrases, not complete reports. They do not establish that Salt Typhoon exercised this feature in any particular operation, or specify targets, prerequisites, scale, reliability, or success. Unprovided reporting cannot be inferred, and omissions do not establish that other capabilities or events never existed.
